newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB shares surge, further short-covering likely.
newsitem.headline: NCB shares surge, further short-covering likely.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) soared for the second straight day on Friday and are expected to stay strong at least until margin-trade sellers complete their short-covering, market sources and analysts said.

However, in the medium to long term, the gains are likely to be cancelled out by NCB's plan to increase capital through new share issues, they said. The share price will also depend on the direction of yields on NCB's debentures, they said.

The bank's share price surged as high as 237 yen in Friday morning trade from Thursday's close of 190 yen. On Thursday, it had briefly traded at 218 yen, up 50 yen from Wednesday's close -- the maximum permissible daily rise.
Brokers said that the upswing was triggered by the announcement of a business alliance between the troubled Japanese long-term credit bank and Bankers Trust New York Corp, a U.S. blue-chip bank.
